game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read value for station 8, then display the same value without changing it. Test dataset 8: {'value': -8}; {'value': 24}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the fire shrine by solving code steps involving slot_matches that move the volcanologist forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the fire shrine first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
